privacy.intro:
Clyzio MB ("we", "us", "our") operates the Hobio mobile application. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use and protect it, and the rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Lithuanian law.

By using Hobio you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
privacy.s2_intro: We collect and process the following categories of personal data:
privacy.s2_b_account_1: Full name and email address (required for registration).
privacy.s2_b_act_1: Groups you join or create, sessions you attend, and preferences.
privacy.s2_b_act_2: Messages and communications sent within the platform.
privacy.s2_b_child_1: Children's first names and age ranges — used solely to match appropriate group recommendations. We do not collect children's email addresses or independent accounts.
privacy.s2_b_tech_1: Device type, operating system version, and app version.
privacy.s2_b_tech_2: IP address and general location (country/city level) for fraud prevention.
privacy.s2_b_pay_1: Transaction references and payment status. Full card data is handled exclusively by our payment processor and is never stored on our servers.
privacy.s3_intro: We process your personal data for the following purposes and legal bases:
privacy.s4_intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with trusted processors who assist us in operating the Service:
privacy.s4_proc_supabase_desc: — database hosting and authentication (servers in EU regions where available).
privacy.s4_proc_expo_desc: — push notification delivery and app distribution.
privacy.s4_footer:
All processors are bound by data processing agreements and are required to process your data only on our instructions and in compliance with GDPR.

We may disclose data to law enforcement or regulatory authorities if required by law or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Hobio, our users, or others.
privacy.s5_body: Some of our processors (e.g. Supabase) may process data outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Where this occurs, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission, to protect your data to EEA standards.
privacy.s6_body:
We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will erase your personal data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain certain records under applicable law (e.g. financial records for tax purposes — up to 10 years under Lithuanian accounting law).

Aggregated, anonymised analytics data may be retained indefinitely as it can no longer identify you.
privacy.s7_intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.right_access_desc: — request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.right_rect_desc: — request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.right_erase_desc: — request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten"), subject to legal retention obligations.
privacy.right_port_desc: — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format and transfer it to another controller.
privacy.right_restrict_desc: — request that we limit the processing of your data in certain circumstances.
privacy.right_object_desc: — object to processing based on legitimate interests, including direct marketing.
privacy.right_withdraw_desc: — withdraw any consent you have given at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
privacy.s7_footer_before: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at
privacy.s7_footer_after: . We will respond within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the State Data Protection Inspectorate of Lithuania (VDAI) at
privacy.s8_body:
The Service is not directed at children under the age of 16. Users registering as parents may add basic information about their children (first name and age group) to facilitate appropriate group recommendations. We do not knowingly create independent accounts for children under 16, and we do not collect more information about children than is necessary for this purpose.

If you believe a child under 16 has provided us with personal data without parental consent, please contact us at info@clyzio.com and we will delete it promptly.
privacy.s9_body:
We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include encrypted data transmission (TLS), access controls, and regular security assessments.

No method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s10_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes through the App or by email at least 14 days before they take effect. The "Effective date" at the top of this page indicates when the current version was last revised.
privacy.s11_intro: For any privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, please contact us:
